objective: Candidate separates media from washers through a screen; PR 740 counts exactly ten tablets from a stock bottle into a counting-tray trough, then closes the tray and bottle.
physical_skill: PR 740 tests bottle opening, granular pouring, spatula-mediated counting, lid closure, and screw-cap manipulation. The candidate tests bimanual screen grasping, load sharing, selective aperture passage, and reseating.
success_condition: PR 740 rewards exactly ten tablets in the trough, remaining tablets in allowed regions, closure states, and no tablet contact or drop. The candidate grades recovered-media fraction plus washer retention, support, release, spill, and damage.
reason: Both manipulate many small rigid bodies, but exact tablet counting and tool-based allocation do not test size-selective sifting.
